Package mayhemlib.recovery

Class UnbeachConfig

java.lang.Object
mayhemlib.recovery.UnbeachConfig
public final class UnbeachConfig extends Object
Tuning for auto unbeach: detecting that the robot has high-centered on fuel from its IMU tilt and driving off it. Distances in meters, speeds in m/s, tilt in degrees.
